resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com use Fourth of July Peak; Forest Lookouts and Willhite use LeClerc (LeClerc Creek and LeClerc Lookout). The Willhite page cites a 1957 map under the LeClerc name.

notes_for_editor: No removal date in any source; the register and firelookout.com say only that the tower is gone. Access is not described in any source read, so the access key is omitted (record says unknown). The Willhite author has not visited. The Forest Lookouts page carries a 'Removed' label. A web search turned up a different former lookout (Kalispell Rock) and a Monumental Mountain lookout, neither used. The Willhite page has a broken character in its title and in the 1933 line, so we quoted only the ASCII part. No photos added. Record other_names include 'Fourth of July (LeClerc Lookout)', which matches the Willhite naming.
